But the central claim -- "G1 is unpassable by construction", "every possible G1 outcome is pre-mapped to 'not HSWM'", "a gate that cannot return PASS under any outcome" -- is contradicted by the repo's own text in four ways:

1. The executable G1 contract has a PASS outcome that does not require beating B2. _research/causal_composition/project.v1.json:131 pass_rule: "Fresh-task gain exceeds the preregistered margin; remove eliminates it; restore recovers it; sham and shuffled-credit arms fail to reproduce it; compiled traversal mediation is observed." The fail_rule (:132) names "static prompt edit", not an adaptive text lesson. CF-02 (control_families[1]) is explicitly about "Frozen RAG, cache, transcript, or text lesson" with intervention "Compare frozen retrieval, text-lesson append, retrieval shuffle, corpus cutoff, and canonical-state removal." An adaptive-B2 tie does not trigger any of these.

2. "A win is attributed to prompt/retrieval content (CF-02)" misreads CF-02. CF-02 is a falsifiable null with a decisive intervention (frozen text-append arm + canonical-state removal); a win that survives it is mapped to a positive verdict: viability :289-290 "H1의 held-out gain이 강한 inherited baseline보다 크고, removal에서 사라지며, restore에서 돌아오고, H2가 재현하지 못해야 local causal HSWM claim 후보가 된다"; :310 -> LOCAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_CANDIDATE; successor 09-03 :188 -> "Candidate LOCAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_UNDER_DECLARED_TASK".

3. The "by construction" tie requires B2 to be an oracle carrying H1's compiled bytes. The repo instead pins B2 to a specific algorithm (priors/expel_b2_text_lesson_v1/README.md: ExpeL commit e41ec9a..., RULE_TEMPLATE, paper cap 10 rules vs YAML max_num_rules 20, KNN/FAISS few-shot retrieval) whose lesson text is LLM-generated. Whether an exact programmatic compiled disposition beats a pinned ExpeL rule list is an empirical question, not a logical impossibility. The only place H1 and B2 compute the identical bit is pre_g1_screen.py, whose B2 arm is literally named B2_SURROGATE with status FROZEN_TEXT_LESSON_SURROGATE_NOT_EXPEL_REPRODUCTION_OR_EXTERNAL_BASELINE (:23-29), terminal PRE_G1_MEASUREMENT_SCREEN_NO_G0_G1_CLAIM (:20), on a one-bit task; reuse-first :150-158 says it "is deliberately below this G1 comparison" and "cannot establish ... comparative HSWM efficacy". Viability :362-363 requires the real G1 task to be one "base model이 풀지 못하지만 한 번의 bounded experience로 학습 가능한 persistent environment" -- not one-bit.

4. The suggested fix (A), a learned routing parameter that changes which route is invoked outside the prompt, already exists in code: src/hswm/effect-runtime/src/canonical-atom-v2-routing-diagnostic.ts:231-237 "Deterministic argmax readout" selectDnrdRoute over credit-updated scoreMicros, and a credit-derived dnrd:routing-disposition atom at canonical-atom-v2-routing-diagnostic-file.ts:209. It is self-labeled LOCAL_EXPERIMENTAL_ROUTING_PAYLOAD_NOT_CANONICAL_PERMIT_NOT_ADMISSION_NOT_LEARNING (routing-diagnostic-process.ts ~:499) and was not chosen for the G1 H1 arm, so "sole channel is compiled prompt text" describes a design choice in g1_micro, not a structural constraint.

What survives, and why MAJOR rather than NONE: the G1 estimand is genuinely unbound and internally inconsistent. The 08-29 JSON contract tolerates a B2 tie; reuse-first :203/:213, viability :311, and the 09-01 synthesis GL-1 (HSWM_GRAPH_AND_LOOP_ENGINEERING_SYNTHESIS_2026-09-01.md:212: falsifier "Matched RAG, lesson, static workflow, sham, shuffled credit, or fixed graph explains gain") treat a matched-lesson tie as a failure of the HSWM delta. results v2 :165-166 admits "'Better than the strongest inherited baseline' is not yet an executable decision rule." reuse-first :186-196 lists three prerequisites before a "powered B2-versus-H1 estimand" can be bound, and git log --since=2026-08-31 filtered on g1|baseline|expel|lesson|prereg returns zero of 35 commits. My own grep of the six governing docs for any stated mechanism (exact/drift/noisy lesson/structured advantage/multi-episode/context budget) found nothing. So the true root issue is "G1 estimand unbound and contradictory across docs, with no written positive hypothesis for H1 over B2" -- a real convergence blocker, but not a gate that is logically closed.

findings.why_it_blocks_completion: The decisive recurrence in the Constitution (docs/canon/HSWM_CONSTITUTION_2026-08-20.md:172-176) ends in 'changed next traversal/transition' of a hypergraph, and counterfactual credit is the step that distinguishes HSWM from prompt-editing (README:148-150). The implemented loop has no traversal, hyperedge, incidence, or weight; its credit rule is literally a prompt instruction and its admitted revision literally a prompt fragment, so the instrument as built can only produce the outcome the G1 contract classifies as not-HSWM. Even a perfect G0 pass on it would establish only that a key-value slot can be written and re-read. Work has moved to Lean/Effect/RDF layers whose own constants declare NOT_CAUSAL_CREDIT_NOT_LEARNING; a programme cannot converge on a mechanism it has stopped writing.

findings.claim: The Constitution 'closes' the target identity (§8) and that identity includes §7.2 인류보편체 — all humanity, all LLMs, the internet, sensors and memory as one cognitive entity — and FCL-8, which spans personal→agent→organization→society scale. The 2026-08-30 adaptive strategy then makes this target immune to evidence: 'the final target is not reduced', TI-1..5 'are not invariants in the sense of successful natural laws' but identity conditions, and every empirical outcome (RED_WITHIN_SCOPE, UNDERDETERMINED, SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE, COMPOSITION_PATH_RED) preserves the target. Consequently the highest label any single experiment can earn is a 'candidate' bounded by scope, and the ladder's upper rungs require what one author cannot supply: G5 needs two HSWMs each with independently owned G1–G4 PASS, G6 needs 'at least one independent implementation or team', and §10.1 'first publishable local discovery candidate' needs independent replication. The repository denies 'complete HSWM' 11 times and never defines an affirmative completion. Eight ladders with ~55 named stages coexist; two have passed (SWM-0R engineering, SWM-0W SUPPORTED_NARROW). The 31 NOT_PROOF_OF_CONSCIOUSNESS disclaimers and 119 distinct negation/UNJUDGED status tokens are the structural consequence.

FCL completion or full HSWM realization" (:364-366), which is exactly the finding's point. votes.reasoning:
STEELMAN (what the repo can honestly say in its own defense):

1. The 인류보편체/society horizon is NOT the measuring stick. The finding claims the target "is measured against" §7.2 and FCL-8. The canon explicitly quarantines that horizon from judgement: docs/canon/HSWM_CONSTITUTION_2026-08-20.md:355 "이는 목표 정체성의 확장이며 현재 구현·효능·의식 융합의 완료 주장이 아니다"; :371-372 "canonical target-identity closure는 architecture decision의 기준점을 닫는다는 제한된 뜻이다"; docs/canon/USER_PRIMARY_HSWM_FRACTAL_COGNITIVE_COMPOSITION_2026-08-28.md:137-138 "유한한 scale의 합성 계약은 무한 재귀 가능성, 무한 확장성, 의식, 인격, 도덕적 지위, 인류보편체 완성을 증명하지 않는다"; :155 FCL-8 is expanded only "개인→agent collective→조직 scale" (organization, not society); docs/research/HSWM_RESEARCH_VIABILITY_AND_POSITIONING_2026-08-30.md:63 "의식·자아·personhood·무한 scale closure | 판정 대상 아님". The gate ladder's top rung is G6 `BOUNDED_REPLICATED_SCALING` and G5 is capped at "exactly two bounded scales" (_research/causal_composition/README.md:236-240, :288-290). So the judged spine is finite. This part of the finding is wrong as a mechanism.

2. A finite affirmative positive IS defined. The finding says the repo "never defines an affirmative completion". VIABILITY §10.1 (:320-331), §9 (:310 `LOCAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_CANDIDATE`), and §12 (:376-385) define one concrete decision experiment and a positive label `LOCAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_UNDER_DECLARED_TASK`; _research/causal_composition/README.md:184 fixes that as the G1 claim ceiling. §11 (:355-368) gives a 7-item priority list, and :367 forbids expanding G2–G5 beyond design before G1. The grep for "complete HSWM" finds only negations because the programme deliberately names its positives by scoped labels, not by "complete".

3. Non-falsifiable hard core is standard Lakatosian methodology, and falsification demonstrably works at mechanism level: ADAPTIVE_RESEARCH_STRATEGY:33-35 pairs "최종 목표는 축소하지 않는다" with "각 경험적 기전과 공개 주장은 독립적으로 RED, UNDERDETERMINED 또는 기각될 수 있다"; P1 slow-weight was actually RED'd (README.md:1108 "scientific RED: 12 staged candidates, 0 fresh-gate passes"). The immunization ban (:112-125) is the opposite of the pathology alleged.

4. "Eight coexisting ladders" overstates. README.md:1148 marks the SWM-0–5 ladder "superseded", :373 "fixed HWAF retired", :98 LakatoTree "retired"; DNRD-5 is "frozen"/"reserved" (docs/research/HSWM_DNRD_4S1_SUCCESSOR_SCIENTIFIC_BOUNDARY_2026-08-28.md:102); P1 is RED. Token persistence is a mandated lineage rule (STRATEGY:119 forbids deleting or unlinking prior RED paths), not eight live ladders. Live ladders are G0–G6 plus frozen DNRD-5. The 31 NOT_PROOF_OF_CONSCIOUSNESS hits are a mechanical NONCLAIMS schema field in DGX preregistration plans (_research/dgx_q1/preregistrations/hswm-dnrd5-dgx-live-q1-v2-2026-08-29/plan.json:22), not 31 independent disclaimers.

5. The next experiment is already sealed and blocked on logistics, not concept: commit 68bd43d 2026-08-30 "preregister sealed ALFWorld B0 calibration"; docs/research/HSWM_G0_FUTURE_OUTCOME_GRAPH_SUCCESSOR_2026-09-03.md:173-176 "The present dev-01 host has neither the DGX execution surface nor the private ALFWorld/model occurrence assets. The sealed ALFWorld B0 occurrence is not consumed here." The Aug 31–Sep 5 commits (Lean admission kernel, Permit commit, G0 phase kernel, Temporal, handoff) map onto explicit G0 contract items — "owner-valid canonical revision", "Make canonical revision remove/restore executable before the first efficacy run", "Seal the trajectory before outcome observation" (_research/causal_composition/README.md:106-119).

WHY THE FINDING STILL SURVIVES (the part the steelman cannot dissolve):

A. The second-party requirement is real, and it has moved DOWN to G0 — the very first rung — as of 2026-09-03. The finding located the one-person blocker at G5/G6; the repo is now stricter than that. HSWM_G0_OCCURRENCE_INTEGRITY_PROFILE_2026-09-03.md:255-277: "The designated external operator must supply and independently audit all of the following before authorizing a live run: ... 5. distinct actor, revision-proposer, occurrence-claimant, WORM-admin, custodian, drand-verifier, evaluator-A, evaluator-B, and completion-auditor subjects, accounts, admin domains ... 6. an independently operated custodian endpoint/key, a second evaluator implementation/control domain, and a completion-auditor qualification record ... the checked-in record remains BLOCKED until those facts exist". HSWM_G0_FUTURE_OUTCOME_GRAPH_SUCCESSOR_2026-09-03.md:186 states outright: "Live BLS-verified future pulse with only local owner/evaluator | ... not CF-07 and not G0." No external operator is designated anywhere (grep over _research/g0_occurrence/ returns no identity; HSWM_G0_EXTERNAL_AUDIT_QUALIFICATION.v1.json status = "BLOCKED"). So under current rules the author alone cannot earn even `MEASUREMENT_READY`; the sealed ALFWorld B0 from Aug 30 would not count either, because §6 of the successor doc (:152-170) now requires an external registration carrier, independent custodian and a second implementation in a separate control domain before any new occurrence may be sealed. This is the sharpest surviving kernel and it is worse than the finding stated.

B. No programme-level done-state exists, by design, and the owner's question presupposes one. The best positive, `LOCAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_UNDER_DECLARED_TASK`, is explicitly "후보" that promotes only "독립 재현 뒤에만" (VIABILITY:383); HSWM_ADAPTIVE_REALIZATION_METHODOLOGY_2026-08-30.md:64 "SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE도 최종 상태가 아니다. 독립 재현, 범위 확장과 다른 FCL gate에는 각각 새 contract가 필요하다". The Lakatosian defense (programmes are progressive/degenerating, never "done") is methodologically sound but it means the honest answer to "왜 완성이 안 되나" is "완성이라는 상태가 정의되어 있지 않다" — and nothing in canon says so in one place. That mismatch between the owner's expectation and the canon's structure is real and explains part of the frustration.

C. The predicted dynamics are observable and self-diagnosed but uncapped. findings.why_it_blocks_completion: An entry gate with no terminating criterion, guarded by the person who also authors the criterion, converts every instrument imperfection into a new prerequisite; a prerequisite list whose newest items depend on each other has no fixed point. Because the HSWM novelty is itself a provenance/governance property, hardening provenance feels like on-target work, so the owner keeps discharging the discharge-able items (Lean, Temporal, RDF, Effect kernels) while the count of un-closable items rises, and the 08-30 cap was ignored within a day. The methodology says this must be recorded as an anti-Ragnarok failure and answered by narrowing the intervention; that recording has not happened.

findings.claim: The canon and AGENTS.md combine four one-directional rules (never weaken a criterion, never delete a RED path or failed theory, every reroute must carry an equal-or-stronger contract, growth of docs/tests/ontology never counts as progress) with zero termination rules — no deadline, time-box, or programme budget anywhere. The strategy states its prohibitions exist so the programme can 'explore for a long time without wrongly declaring arrival', and the only permitted verdicts are 'replace this mechanism' or 'supported within scope, next scale not licensed', so a decision to stop, ship, or declare a gate passed on current evidence is structurally unavailable. Combined with 'do not default to code or tests' and singleton preregistrations, this produced two dead stretches: 73 consecutive commits (Aug 21-27) with zero experiment work, which the owner killed as 'sprawl', and the current 47-commit / 93,131-line tail (Aug 31-Sep 5) with zero bytes added to results/ or evidence/, executed on a dev-01 host the project says has no DGX surface, against 8 preconditions none of which is a code deliverable. The add:delete ratio since 08-20 is 40:1.

findings.why_it_blocks_completion: A programme whose rules can only add obligations and can never emit 'passed on current evidence' or 'stop' has no fixed point other than indefinite growth; without a time-box every unmet precondition becomes a licence to build more substrate on whichever host is at hand. The owner has already detected and killed this pattern once (Aug 23-24) and it re-emerged within a week at larger scale, showing it is a structural property of the working rules, not a lapse. The owner's question ('ideas seem sufficient, why never completed') is answered by the rulebook itself: it is optimized, in its own words, for exploring for a long time without declaring arrival.

Commit counts are 77 after 671eab9 and 67 after ac2327b; '47' matches neither. The defensible claim is 'after the v2 result on 08-30 15:11Z, 67 commits and zero experiments'.

MISCHARACTERIZED MECHANISM: 'each void singleton was consumed and replaced by a new instrument instead of a rerun.' The opaque pilot v1 (preregistered 08e4051 12:52Z, wrapper run g1-opaque-identifiability-9ff36ce-v1) failed on a pure instrument defect (no bare `python` in the pinned image) and v2 was qualified (31a0035 14:18Z) and run 14:32-14:41Z with 'task, arms, estimands, thresholds, episode set, and call schedule ... unchanged' (_research/causal_composition/preregistrations/g1_opaque_identifiability_pilot_v2_2026-08-30/README.md:3-10, 17-22). votes.reasoning:
STEELMAN ATTEMPTED (four defenses), then verdict on each.

Defense 1 - "the rules do not forbid a v3; they forbid rerunning the consumed occurrence". This is correct as far as it goes. The v2 stopping rule (_research/causal_composition/preregistrations/g1_opaque_identifiability_pilot_v2_2026-08-30/protocol.v1.json:227 "No retry, replacement, refill, resume ... or second occurrence") is occurrence-scoped. docs/canon/HSWM_ADAPTIVE_RESEARCH_STRATEGY_2026-08-30.md section 4 explicitly permits a successor "동일하거나 더 강한 성공기준·대조군으로 새 contract 사전등록", and section 2 lists "outcome source와 credit estimator" and "G0–G6를 포함한 현재 연구 순서의 세부 구현과 instrument" as replaceable auxiliary hypotheses. So the finding's phrase "the rules forbid any second occurrence" overstates. BUT the defense does not rescue the project: the real blocker is the project's own post-hoc choice, recorded in results/HSWM_G1_OPAQUE_IDENTIFIABILITY_V2_RESULTS_2026-08-30.md:193-195 ("fresh preregistration with an independently owned outcome/evaluation boundary") and results/raw/hswm_g1_opaque_identifiability_v2_2026-08-30/public_redacted_projection.json next_research.required_deltas[0] = INDEPENDENTLY_OWNED_OUTCOME_AND_EVALUATION_BOUNDARY. That choice is stricter than the G0 contract itself: _research/causal_composition/README.md:123-124 requires only "Keep outcome production independent of the action producer and revision proposer" (a role/process condition), while README:279-280 assigns replication across "evaluator ownership, and at least one independent implementation or team" to G6. The project pulled a G6 obligation into G0, and nothing in the USER_PRIMARY sources requires it (docs/canon/HSWM_CONSTITUTION_2026-08-20.md:239 says only "independently attributable outcome"; grep of docs/canon/*.md for "independently owned" returns nothing). So the finding's mechanism survives with a corrected attribution: not "the rules", but a self-chosen required delta that canon allows the owner to revise.

Defense 2 - "the DNRD chain WAS repair-and-rerun, just with fresh identities". This defense HOLDS for DNRD-1 through 4S1 and refutes part of the finding. results/HSWM_DNRD_2_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULTS_2026-08-28.md:196-200 says the successor must "fix the durable-ledger path validation/read bug and execute that exact branch through terminal write"; DNRD-3:255-270 likewise enumerates bug fixes. Timeline (git log --date=iso): DNRD-1 void 76d5500 08-27 15:59 -> DNRD-2 prereg 3b4d424 17:31; DNRD-2 refused 3846be6 08-28 01:27 -> DNRD-3 prereg 5ca0bf0 02:54; DNRD-3 void 43c1b98 04:55 -> DNRD-4/4S1 prereg b1dc53d 08:54 / 92efba5 09:51. That is repair-and-rerun within hours, which is essentially the finding's own suggested 24h rule; the cost was the re-freeze/re-ratify/public-pulse ceremony, not a ban. What does NOT hold is the DNRD-5 branch: Q0 (SOURCE_A_REFUSED, 0 causal calls), Q1 (96/96 calls, 0 causal), MI-1 (16 POSTs), MI-2 (48 POSTs) spent ~160 generation calls on inference-byte exactness, and MI-2 itself concluded "inference-byte stability is not HSWM learning" (results/HSWM_DNRD5_QCASE024_MI2_RANDOMIZED_LAUNCH_RESULTS_2026-08-30.md:216-218). That is genuine instrument fan-out away from the HSWM question.

Defense 3 - "the MI-2 sentence in the finding is false". HOLDS. MI-2 result 671eab9 is 2026-08-30 03:04; the G1 micro exploratory result d423194 landed 09:35 and the opaque v2 result ac2327b at 15:11 the same day. Both are outcome->credit->revision->fresh-behavior occurrences with remove/restore arms (results/HSWM_G1_MICRO_EXPLORATORY_RESULTS_2026-08-30.md:9-11; v2 results:100-107). `git rev-list --count 671eab9..HEAD` = 77, and the 2nd-10th of those are exactly the experiments the finding says never happened. The correct statement is the post-v2 one: `git rev-list --count ac2327b..HEAD` = 67, and `git log --since=2026-08-31 -- results evidence _research/causal_composition/preregistrations F1_R8_RESULTS_LOG.md EFFICACY.md` is empty.

Defense 4 - "post-08-31 work is the required prerequisite for the declared next step (ExpeL B2 comparator per viability section 11.2; G0 occurrence integrity for required_deltas[0])". Partially holds: the two ExpeL commits (6130440, 25947d2) are on the project's own priority list, and docs/research/HSWM_G0_FUTURE_OUTCOME_GRAPH_SUCCESSOR_2026-09-03.md section 6 item 7 selects B2 prospectively. But the integrity work fails the project's own tests: README.md:133-134 "do not add a more elaborate judge or ontology as a substitute"; docs/research/HSWM_RESEARCH_VIABILITY_AND_POSITIONING_2026-08-30.md section 11.1 "instrument provenance를 완벽하게 만드는 작업이 valid causal observation보다 커지면 멈춘다" and section 7.6 names "instrument failure마다 더 큰 judge나 governance layer를 추가한다" as a Ragnarok failure signal. docs/research/HSWM_G0_OCCURRENCE_INTEGRITY_PROFILE_2026-09-03.md section 3 lists 13 new modules (OSF readback, DSSE, Rekor/RFC3161, S3 Object Lock WORM, Temporal, drand, dual evaluator, Cosign auditor, RO-Crate, OpenLineage ...) and section 5 lists 7 external prerequisites "the designated external operator must supply"; docs/operations/HSWM_G0_TYPESCRIPT_TEMPORAL_AUTHORITY_2026-09-04.md section 8 lists 7 more live-admission gates. No document after 08-30 re-evaluates the burden cap (grep "burden cap" outside the viability doc returns nothing). So this is a prerequisite only under the ownership reading that canon assigns to G6.

Defense 5 - "no DGX since 08-31, so no experiment was possible". UNSUPPORTED. The only text is HSWM_G0_FUTURE_OUTCOME_GRAPH_SUCCESSOR_2026-09-03.md:175-176 "The present dev-01 host has neither the DGX execution surface nor the private ALFWorld/model occurrence assets", but dev-01 was already the dev host during the 08-28..30 DGX runs (docs/operations/HSWM_PROXMOX_RESEARCH_FABRIC_2026-08-28.md:39-43), and no commit or doc since 08-31 records DGX loss (`git log --since=2026-08-31 --grep=DGX -i` empty). Cannot be confirmed either way; not a defense on the evidence.

Defense 6 - "ALFWorld B0 blockers were genuine external faults". Holds as to cause (Inform7 aarch64, AppArmor userns, vLLM #50067 per preregistrations/alfworld_b0_calibration_2026-08-30/README.md:12-60) but not as to outcome: the preregistration directory contains only README, requirements, protocol, contract and a patch (no run output); protocol.v1.json:77 "B0_NOT_RUN"; last code touch 23a40ba 08-30 23:28; the 09-03 successor doc :176-177 confirms "The sealed ALFWorld B0 occurrence is not consumed here". Comparators unrun survives.

Defense 7 - "28 opened / 1 closed undercounts closures". Partially holds: since 08-20 SWM-0R (engineering PASS), SWM-0W scalar (SUPPORTED_NARROW), DNRD-5 Q1 ("finite exactness falsified") and MI-2 all closed with verdicts. But closures about the outcome->credit->revision->held-out-behavior question specifically: zero. The direction of the finding holds; its exact counts are loose.

VERDICT: not refuted. What survives and directly explains non-convergence: (a) after v2 the owner escalated the G0 independence requirement from role/process independence (README:123-124) to ownership independence (a G6 item per README:279-280) and then spent ~65 commits building an external-custody chain with 7+7 prerequisites no solo researcher can satisfy, contrary to README:133-134 and viability 11.1/7.6; (b) the v2 residual defect (position bias, v2 results:114-126) is cheap to fix - g1_micro.py:508,564 already carries candidate-order counterbalance machinery - and the out-of-process verifier already returned VALID, so a single-owner v3 is feasible under canon; (c) the DNRD-5 Source-A exactness branch consumed four occurrences with zero causal calls; (d) ALFWorld B0 and ExpeL B2 remain unexecuted. What does NOT survive: the "rules forbid" framing (blocker is a self-chosen delta), the "no repaired rerun" characterization of DNRD-1..4S1 (they were hour-scale repaired reruns), and the MI-2 sentence (false; G1-micro and opaque-v2 ran within 12 hours of MI-2). Severity stays MAJOR because the surviving core is the proximate cause of the zero-experiment stretch from 08-31 to 09-05.
votes.what_would_change_my_mind: Any of: (1) a checked-in record dated after 2026-08-30 showing the DGX/GB10 host or the private holdout assets became unavailable, which would make scaffolding the only possible work; (2) a USER_PRIMARY source in docs/canon/sources/ that requires evaluator/outcome *ownership* independence (not merely role/process independence) at G0, which would make the required_deltas[0] escalation owner-mandated rather than self-imposed; (3) a preregistration or commit scheduling a single-owner, separate-process-evaluator v3 with randomized candidate position and a concrete run date, or an executed ALFWorld B0 / ExpeL B2 occurrence, which would show the comparator and rerun path is not actually blocked; (4) a post-08-30 burden-cap evaluation per viability section 11.1 that justifies the 13-module integrity chain as smaller than the causal observation it enables.

findings.why_it_blocks_completion: A programme converges by closing questions. Here each failed occurrence spawns a stricter instrument with a new singleton preregistration rather than a rerun with the bug fixed, so open threads grow monotonically (28 opened, 1 closed) and the one question that matters (does an admitted revision change held-out behavior?) has never been asked with n > 8. The cheapest path to a G0 pass under the original definition is a ~10-minute re-run of an instrument that already works with two protocol edits and a second-key evaluator process; the no-rerun/no-second-occurrence and ownership rules convert that into an indefinite wait for external custody, and the comparator arms needed for G1 have been engineered to the edge of execution and left unrun.

findings.claim: AGENTS.md and Constitution §9 require every change to be preceded by a canonical-role / conceptual-delta preamble, discourage defaulting to code or tests, and pair canon documents with checked-in KG projections. Under an LLM-agent session workflow this makes one dated boundary document + one JSON projection version + one hash-pinning test the unit of work: 25 NEXT_SESSION docs (7,237 lines, 17 minted on 08-23), a handoff KG at v27 with 23 hash tests (10,065 lines) that had to be globally ignored, a graph-loop ontology at v6 (106KB->370KB in two days), README edited 28 and INDEX 47 times in 16 days. The repo pins SHA-256 of files that change daily (design docs, pyproject.toml) inside tests and TS source under a rule that hash-bound records must never be rewritten; the pyproject pin was rebound five times then frozen on 09-03, so the full vitest suite is permanently 2-failed and the docs record this as accepted. The project measured one such episode at 106,955 additions for 23 deletions with no material result, then broke its own 'no v26/v27' stop rule five days later. Ontology projections are hand-maintained Python literals (10,862 lines of builders; the S2S handoff JSONs had no builder at all), so they churn with every doc.

STEELMAN (what the maintainer can legitimately say):

1. The three Bools are a documented trusted-adapter boundary, not an oversight, and they are not "caller-asserted" in the sense of forgeable. formal/HSWMVerifiedAdmissionKernel.lean:5-15 states "Its three adapter facts are supplied by the surrounding runtime: signature/envelope verification, verification-time checking, and exact recovered-state-byte checking ... They do not establish that Node, Effect, Ed25519, a clock, a byte codec, or a filesystem produced truthful facts"; formal/HSWMLocalPermitCommit.lean:9-16 says the same. On the TS side the gateway's hard-coded `adapterFacts: {…: true}` (canonical-atom-v2-verified-admission-gateway.ts:88-89, inside `wireRequest(preflight)`) is only reachable from the backend's `admission` callback, which runs after real Ed25519 envelope verification (canonical-atom-v2-local-permit-commit.ts:956 `verifyCanonicalPermitEnvelopeAgainstCallerSuppliedContext(request.envelopeBytes…)`), SHA-256 state-digest checks (:963), nonce replay (:965 `NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`), and genesis/prior-head checks (:967-968). So "caller-supplied" = "TS-verified then asserted", which is the standard TCB decomposition (crypto outside the proved kernel). The finding's suggested fix (verify Ed25519/SHA-256 inside Lean) would be a far larger formal sink than the current design and contradicts the finding's own opportunity-cost thesis.

2. Placeholder digests in the KAT are a non-issue: the wire only enforces a 64-lowercase-hex grammar (formal/HSWMVerifiedAdmissionWire.lean:53) and the kernel never claims to check digest content. HONEST JUDGMENT (what survives the steelman):

a) The core technical claim is correct and the defense does not dispute it: the Lean kernel does no byte-level work and re-decides a 10-conjunct predicate (formal/HSWMLocalPermitCommit.lean:146-160) that the TS backend has already decided at local-permit-commit.ts:956-968 plus `validHeadTransition` (:146 `sequence + 1`). "Verified admission" is therefore an N-version re-execution of TS's own checks via a 118 MB subprocess; the Lean file itself concedes the achievable evidence is "Differential runtime tests" (HSWMLocalPermitCommit.lean:13). Counting this as PS-2 `SUPPORTED_IN_SCOPE` (proof-status:117) is generous naming, exactly as the finding says.

b) The plan does still commit to extending it. docs/research/HSWM_END_TO_END_RUNTIME_REFINEMENT_LEAN_BOUNDARY_2026-08-31.md:311 "The next valid route remains proof-first but must eventually cross into real execution", with steps 1-3 (§9) all being link/certificate/issuer work before step 4 (world outcome). Proof-status §6 (:184-188) orders "PS-3를 bounded theorem으로 자른다" and "한 실제 transition을 끝까지 연결한다" as steps 1-2, ahead of PS-5 (step 4) and PS-6 (step 5); PS-3's next gate (:118) is "verified source semantics, extraction or bounded simulation theorem", which does not exist for TypeScript/Node and is a research programme in itself. That the last five days deviated toward G0 scaffolding does not remove this standing ordering from the canonical status document.

c) Tests silently `return` without the binary (gateway-v2.test.ts:49,99; gateway.test.ts:37,93,117) and no workflow in .github/ builds Lean — confirmed, but this is hygiene, immaterial to completion.

d) Line count: link modules (TSV1 142 + EndToEnd 818 + ExecCertWire 922 + LocalPermitCommit 316 + Kernel 228 + Wire 297 + Persisted 188 + CLI 34 + PermitEnvelope 320) ≈ 3,265 of 7,350 Lean lines, i.e. more than the finding's ~2,300, plus ~1,600 TS/test lines in the gateway/tests alone.

Net: the finding's framing is overstated in three places ("caller-asserted" implies forgeable; "sustains the illusion" — the docs are explicit; "every hour" — it was ~1 day and stopped). Its substance stands: the machinery adds no admission semantics beyond a redundant re-check, PS-3 as written is unreachable, and the status documents keep "proof-first" ahead of the experiment. That is a symptom of the wider verification-ceremony-before-experiment pattern rather than a cause of non-convergence on its own, so MINOR is the right severity — not NONE, because the standing plan text still routes future effort here, and not MAJOR, because the actual work since 09-02 did not follow that route and G0 is Lean-independent.

findings.why_it_blocks_completion: It does not block completion directly, but it sustains the illusion that a 'universal TS→Lean refinement' (PS-3) is a matter of extending existing machinery, and it justified ~2,300 lines of wire/codec Lean and hundreds of TS/test lines that verify nothing about admission semantics.
